movie.title: The Last Scene
movie.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A woman blessed with prophetic dreams falls into a perilous love affair with a mysterious man, forcing her to choose between altering fate and risking everything.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Selen possesses a rare and burdening gift: the ability to foresee the future of anyone she encounters through her vivid dreams. Intending to use her visions to reclaim control over her own life and safeguard those around her, her world shifts dramatically when she meets Kemal. Their immediate, intense connection ignites a passionate romance that quickly plunges them both into deep danger. As fate and free will collide, Selen must navigate harrowing choices where every step could rewrite their shared destiny.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Selen leads a life overshadowed by an extraordinary yet terrifying supernatural ability. Every night, her dreams reveal precise, unalterable glimpses into the future of the people around her, burdening her with knowledge she never asked to carry. Tired of remaining a passive spectator to tragedy, Selen resolves to actively use her prophetic visions to rewrite fate, aiming to improve her own circumstances and protect her loved ones. However, her careful plans unravel when she crosses paths with Kemal, a man whose presence immediately triggers intense, chaotic visions of passion and impending peril. Drawn together by an undeniable magnetism, Selen and Kemal quickly become entangled in a dangerous romantic relationship that threatens to destroy the stability she fought so hard to build. As external threats mount and the dangers foretold in her dreams begin to materialize in real life, Selen realizes that trying to alter destiny carries a devastating price. Kemal's secretive past and the forces pursuing him push Selen to the absolute limit of her abilities, testing the boundaries of her love and resilience. In a desperate race against time, she is forced to confront the ultimate dilemma: whether to accept the future revealed in her sleep or sacrifice everything to change their final outcome.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Last Scene is a high-stakes dramatic narrative centered on Selen, a woman cursed and blessed with the ability to see future events through her dreams. Determined to step out of the shadows of passive observation, she embarks on a journey to use her precognitive powers to alter the course of her life and safeguard those she holds dear. Her mission takes a complicated, dangerous turn when she encounters Kemal, a compelling stranger whose arrival marks the beginning of a whirlwind romance fraught with hidden threats and intense emotion. As Selen struggles to navigate the dangerous consequences of interfering with destiny, she and Kemal are drawn deeper into a web of suspense and passion, where every decision carries profound consequences for their future together.

story_structure.climax: Selen is forced to confront her most critical vision yet, placing her at a major crossroads where she must make a high-stakes choice that will irrevocably determine their fate.
story_structure.conflict: When Selen meets Kemal, a deep connection quickly develops between them, thrusting her into a dangerous romance where her visions begin to conflict with the rising perils of their shared path.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of Selen's ultimate decision unfolds, shaping a new reality for both Selen and Kemal as they face the long-term consequences of altering their destiny.
story_structure.introduction: Selen discovers and navigates her ability to foresee other people's futures through her dreams, seeking to use this unique gift to change her life and help those around her.
story_structure.risingAction: As passion and peril intensify around their relationship, Selen must navigate increasingly complex future visions while trying to protect Kemal and alter the dangerous trajectories she foresees.
